items.title: ‘Wow, it’s a real discovery’: Claude cracks a 25-year NSA number mystery
items.summary: Numbers the spy agency handed over in the 1990s, long suspected of hiding a backdoor, turn out to have come from a basic computer program. Bitcoin was never on that list, and its quantum problem hasn’t gone anywhere.

items.title: Big Tech's AI auditors will only see what they're shown
items.summary: If the White House accord's audits are going to be worth anything, auditors should be able to choose what they test, writes Samuel Vance-Law, head of research at the Decentralization Research Center.

items.title: Quantum Alliance forms amid warnings 6.4 million bitcoin face future quantum threat
items.summary: Nine crypto companies launched the Quantum Alliance to jointly prepare for quantum attacks, but they disagree on when the threat will arrive and whether vulnerable BTC should be frozen.

items.title: Ledger’s early implant warnings deserved more action, Karpelès says
items.summary: Ledger was contacted about tampered hardware wallets risks months before its latest security crisis, with former Mt. Gox CEO Mark Karpelès questioning its response.

items.title: Sweden revisits digital krona as ECB advances digital euro plans
items.summary: Sweden’s Riksbank has recommended that lawmakers prepare for a possible digital krona, citing concerns over foreign-currency stablecoins and the future of domestic payments.

items.title: SequenceHash: multihashing for the rest of us
items.summary: Multihashing is one of those cryptographic tasks that’s easy not to think about too much. This is unfortunate, because multihashing is a common stumbling point when cryptographers try to use hashes. As part of our goal to “fix software, not bugs,” Trail of Bits is introducing Seq

items.title: Chip-stock bets lost $52 million in 10 minutes with Wall Street shut
items.summary: A 10-minute flush hit round-the-clock chip-stock contracts while U.S. markets were shut, leaving traders with no real share price to lean on.

items.title: Circle defends USDC economics as stablecoin rivals court its partners with bigger cut
items.summary: Coinbase, Circle’s largest USDC partner, also backs Open USD, a rival network that passes reserve income to partners after a management fee.

items.title: Cysic crypto bridge halted after unauthorized mint of 10M CYS
items.summary: Cysic said the incident was limited to bridge message processing and minting and did not affect the mainnet or other operational systems.

items.title: Chinese suspect in $75M international crime network arrested in Bangkok
items.summary: Police alleged the suspect was involved in cryptocurrency and foreign-currency exchanges for criminal groups across more than 133 accounts.

items.title: Tether backs AIsa as strategic investor, completing seed extension round
items.summary: The round brings AIsa’s total funding to more than $9 million.

items.title: Goldman, Wells Fargo, Morgan Stanley see tokenization as a growth play, not a threat
items.summary: The largest banks in the world are eyeing new trading opportunities, speeding up payments and a role for advisers as tokenization takes root in Wall Street.

items.title: Citrini sees a tokenization boom. The harder question is who profits
items.summary: The influential research firm says real-world assets could finally give blockchains a clear role in finance. For investors, the next challenge is figuring out which companies, networks and protocols capture the revenue.

items.title: Polygon sees Coinme acquisition as entry to payments sector dominated by Visa, Stripe
items.summary: CEO Marc Boiron said the Coinme acquisition will help Polygon control customer relationships and capture revenue that previously went to payment intermediaries.

items.title: Banks could slow stablecoin growth by paying savers more, BIS paper finds
items.summary: A BIS working paper found a 1 basis point rise in U.S. bank deposit rates predicted slower stablecoin growth, cutting ten-week growth from 15% to 12%.

items.title: Satoshi-era bitcoin faces a bigger quantum threat after Google’s new Willow breakthrough
items.summary: Google says its Willow chip can prepare the special quantum states needed for advanced calculations with about 40 times fewer errors, reducing one of the hardware bottlenecks behind any future attempt to crack bitcoin wallets.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Solana shows resilience, but some areas need continued observation, Fidelity says
items.summary: Solana has had no reported mainnet outages in two years, but concentrations in stake, hosting and client software should be monitored, according to a report.

items.title: Circle’s Allaire says stablecoin issuer looking to enter 40 developing markets: Report
items.summary: Markets in Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa and the Middle East see increasing demand for stablecoins.

items.title: Lagarde says euro-area economy is resilient, digital euro under development
items.summary: “The digital euro will further stimulate innovation and competition in retail payments,” according to the ECB president.
